verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime's docs show an extremely broad API surface (account opening, KYC, ACH, wires, book transfers, card issuance/lifecycle, disputes, statements, webhooks, account locking/closing) suggesting the API is the primary interface for nearly all banking operations, consistent with an API-first platform. However, there is no explicit statement or audit confirming full UI/API parity, and the dashboard's exact feature set isn't documented for comparison. Missing for 10: explicit UI-vs-API parity claim, documentation of any dashboard-only features, and independent verification that no functionality is UI-exclusive.
